practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 鴑 ingqe, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Revenge believes that pain can be balanced by being copied. It cannot. The copy multiplies, and the family becomes a ledger. Mercy is the refusal to become the injury.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 鴑 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 鴒 ingqe, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A marriage can survive a true no. It cannot survive a no that was only a wound looking for a second body. Protection is the no that guards the bond, not the no that wins the evening.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 鴒 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 鴕 ingqe, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A parent who comes down to a child's height does not lose rank. Rank was the costume. The person remains. Dignity is the choice to be seen without requiring worship.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 鴕 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 鴗 ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A family that can clap for its own is already rich. The eye is the first thief, and it can be the first blessing. The difference is whether the good is allowed to remain in the other hand.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 鴗 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 鴘 ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The parent at the dark door does not stop being afraid. They stop leaving. Be with the frightened. Do not perform fearlessness. A performed bravery teaches a child to hide.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 鴘 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 鴛 ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Generosity is not the opposite of need. It is need that has remembered other mouths. The first portion, not the remainder, teaches the house what it is.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 鴛 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 鴝 ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Healing speech is not sweetness. Sweetness can be a lie. Healing speech is accuracy with mercy. It names the hurt and refuses the insult that wanted to ride along.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 鴝 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 鴞 ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
What is despised at home is despised twice, because home was the place it should have been safe to be plain. Appreciation is looking that did not turn away.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 鴞 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 鴟 ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Cold silence is absence wearing a body. Presence is that silence warmed by staying. Put the object down. Let the eyes finish the sentence the mouth is not ready to speak.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 鴟 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 鴣 ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
A family that cannot mend becomes a set of strangers who still share a key. Mercy here is not amnesia. It is the refusal to make the break the only story the children inherit.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 鴣 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 鴦 ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The empty chair is not decorated away. The shawl is the theology. Every house that lasted taught its people to weep with those who weep, and only then to speak.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 鴦 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 鴨 ingqe, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Hope, in the old sense, is not a mood and not a forecast. It is the small fidelity of looking again. Families are made of that looking: one more morning, one more place set.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 鴨 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 鴪 ingqe, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The open hand and the cup of water do not erase the wrong. They stop the wrong from becoming the family name. The account can be told. It does not have to be continued.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 鴪 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 鴫 ingqe, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children learn what strength is from the body that stands between them and the weather. If that body spends itself on them, they learn that love arrives as weather. Turn the heat toward the actual danger.

This is the work of an elder with the young. Here the body speaks by ingqe, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 鴫 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.
